registration_timing: after sealed v0.2.2 checkpoint-splice outcomes, before any model-weight-by-AdamW-moment swap outcome
status_label: model-weight by AdamW-moment by suffix decomposition at the sealed E2048 cancellation checkpoint
claim_scope: deterministic saturated 2x2x2 continuation decomposition within one post-outcome-selected R64 residual-loop construction; no uncertainty-calibrated dominance, Transformer, task-performance, asymptotic, or general optimizer-state claim

frozen_training.chunk_strategy: one hybrid checkpoint continuation cell at a time
frozen_training.checkpoint_interval: terminal checkpoint for every new swap cell

component_integrity_gate.model_state: tensor exact against the selected sealed E2048 model checkpoint immediately before continuation
component_integrity_gate.optimizer_state: tensor exact, including AdamW first and second moments and step counters, against the selected sealed E2048 optimizer checkpoint immediately before continuation
component_integrity_gate.metadata: both source checkpoints must report E2048 and optimizer step 4
component_integrity_gate.failure_rule: stop before the first continuation update for the affected cell

registered_endpoints.dominance_rule: largest absolute factorial effect must be at least 1.5 times the second-largest absolute effect; otherwise factorial_unresolved
registered_endpoints.inferential_boundary: the saturated eight-cell deterministic fit has zero residual degrees of freedom, so dominance is descriptive and has no uncertainty interval

claim_boundary: The intervention crosses model weights and complete AdamW state from two sealed E2048 checkpoints with two deterministic post-checkpoint data suffixes. It can decompose endpoint rebound in this one R64 construction into descriptive factorial effects, but its saturated single-cell-per-combination design cannot estimate uncertainty, identify individual batches or moment tensors, or generalize to Transformers, task performance, asymptotic depth, other optimizers, or other task families.

resources.foreign_gpu_process_policy: observe and abort before launch; never terminate foreign processes
